description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy (%) of various reinforcement learning methods—DAPO, SRPO, PPO, and GRPO—both with and without self-reflection, across three distinct domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, with tick marks at intervals of 2%. The horizontal axis lists the three domains. For each domain, grouped bars represent the performance of different methods, with distinct patterns and colors indicating the method and whether self-reflection is applied. In Mathverse, DAPO+Self-reflection achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 56.2%, followed by SRPO at around 55.8%, DAPO at 53.1%, GRPO at 53.5%, and PPO+Self-reflection at 53.3%. In MMLU, DAPO+Self-reflection again leads with an accuracy of about 57.0%, followed by SRPO at 57.1%, DAPO at 55.8%, GRPO at 55.6%, and PPO+Self-reflection at 54.6%. In Physics, DAPO+Self-reflection shows the highest accuracy at approximately 60.8%, followed by SRPO at 60.6%, DAPO at 57.5%, GRPO at 58.1%, and PPO+Self-reflection at 57.0%. The chart demonstrates that methods incorporating self-reflection generally achieve higher accuracy, with DAPO+Self-reflection consistently performing among the top across all domains.
